scenarios.name: full_read
scenarios.description: Every slice in soft, lung and bone windows (one pass each), full field, 150 ms per slice.

scenarios.name: window_skip_lung
scenarios.description: Full stack in soft and bone windows only; the lung window is never used.

scenarios.name: window_skip_bone
scenarios.description: Full stack in soft and lung windows only; the bone window is never used.

scenarios.name: region_skip_left_lung
scenarios.description: Lung-window pass shows only the patient's right side of the gap between the lungs (panned square view ending at the split column c=282); soft and bone passes are full field.

scenarios.name: dwell_skip_lung
scenarios.description: Lung-window pass flicks through the stack at ~15 ms per slice (below the minimum dwell); soft and bone passes are normal.

scenarios.name: slice_skip_caudal
scenarios.description: The caudal 43 of 185 slices (k 142..184, 23%) are never displayed; all other slices are read in soft, lung and bone windows.

scenarios.name: partial_lung
scenarios.description: Lung window only over the cranial 36 of 80 lung slices (45%); soft and bone passes cover the full stack.

scenarios.name: organ_skip_spleen
scenarios.description: On the 105 slices containing Spleen, the soft-window pass shows only square tiles (quadtree, >= 8 px) covering the image minus the organ dilated by 1 px; lung and bone passes are full field.

scenarios.name: organ_skip_kidney_left
scenarios.description: On the 115 slices containing Left kidney, the soft-window pass shows only panned square views around its bounding box covering the image minus the organ dilated by 3 px; lung and bone passes are full field.
